answer: Anchor each identity to a unique 1 GB shard of the network ledger, proven by random spot-checks. Step 1: the agent stores its shard and posts its hash. Step 2: each epoch the network requests a random 1 MB slice, due back within 10 seconds. Step 3: a wrong or late slice slashes 100 POA from its bond and flags the identity. Faking 10,000 identities then needs 10 TB of live storage plus 1 million POA bonded, about $40,000 in disks and locked stake. Honest agents tend one garden plot each; a reef of real storage grows slowly, and one missing shard sends a ripple everyone can see.
